items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: the one for Jimmy Smith was done at the Apollo Theater, and the one for Lionel Hampton was done at the Metropole, which was a club at that time.

ctx.x: No kidding? Tell me about that.

And so I said you know we have some wonderful artists in town, and I’d like to give some awards, and those artists are Lionel Hampton, Bud Powell and Jimmy Smith. And they got the awards together, and I went and presented these awards through their auspices. And the one for Bud Powell was done at Birdland, the one for Jimmy Smith was done at the Apollo Theater, and the one for Lionel Hampton was done at the Metropole, which was a club at that time. So those were, you know, sort of everything happened at night.…
well. And I knew he was troubling. And so to give him some recognition while he was still with us, meant a lot to me.
